risks.title: Interest Rate Exposure
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned in Item 7A (mid-level position), moderate language ('may impact interest income recognized in the future'), stable versus prior year, Capital category with medium weighting. Absence of variable-rate borrowings as of January 31, 2026 mitigates exposure.

risks.title: Reliability of Significant Accounting Estimates
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned at beginning of notes (high position in financial statements), explicit language ('Actual results could differ materially'), stable versus prior year, Industry category with standard weighting. Affects multiple key items including inventory and insurance reserves.

risks.title: Banking Concentration Risk on Cash
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in accounting notes (mid-level position in report), factual language ('could potentially subject the Company to concentrations of credit risk'), stable versus prior year, Credit category with moderate weighting. Diversification across institutions partially mitigates this risk.

risks.title: Management and Valuation of Deferred Inventory
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in accounting notes (mid-level position in report), neutral language addressing major balance sheet item (2.6 Bn), stable versus prior year, Industry category. Packaway model is central to Ross's business model and exposes company to depreciation and deseasoning risks.

risks.title: Potential Impairment of Property and Equipment Assets
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in accounting notes (mid-to-late position in report), standard conditional language ('may not be recoverable'), stable versus prior year, Industry category with standard weighting. With over 4 Bn in net assets, significant impairment would impact balance sheet.
